feeds.title: February newspaper
feeds.description: February newspaper is a comprehensive weekly Libyan newspaper issued by the General Press Authority.

feeds.title: Libya Al-Ahrar
feeds.description: Libya Al-Ahrar features real and thorough news and reports from Libya.

feeds.title: Ean Libya
feeds.description: Ean Libya is a comprehensive media network, interested in Libyan and international affairs, conveying the latest developments in real time around the clock with news and analysis.

feeds.title: Al-Marsad Libyan
feeds.description: Al-Marsad Libyan daily electronic newspaper is comprehensive and concerned with local and international affairs in all its aspects.

feeds.title: Al-Tanasuh
feeds.description: At Al-Tanasuh, we bring you the latest and groundbreaking news and reports. We offer different programs, special coverage, policies, and more to our readers.

feeds.title: Libya Herald
feeds.description: The Libya Herald first appeared on 17 February 2012 since then, it has become a favourite go-to source on news about Libya, for many in Libya and around the world. Our aim is to cover every aspect of society in Libya: politics, business, sport, culture, education, construction and infrastructure, and more.

feeds.title: Libya Panorama Channel
feeds.description: Libya Panorama TV is a Libyan channel broadcasting from the heart of the capital, Tripoli. It was established in 2014, in light of the political conflict. Today you can read news on Sports, Business, the Economy, and more.

feeds.title: Libya Al Salam
feeds.description: Libya Al Salam electronic newspaper is an independent Libyan newspaper issued from Benghazi, Libya. It aims to educate, raise awareness, guide and inform the public of what is useful for the benefit of the country and the citizen by using various types of press materials in professional and high quality.

feeds.title: NewLibya
feeds.description: News and analytical site that broadcasts quick news and political, economic, cultural and social reports on Libya.

feeds.title: Libya 24.news
feeds.description: Libya 24 News Agency is an independent Libyan news channel specialized in Libyan affairs. It follows Libya's news with high professionalism and gives details to its readers.

feeds.title: Libya News
feeds.description: Libya News, the first Libyan news search engine is a site that publishes the latest news in Libya today from all sources every minute in one place.

feeds.title: Libyan News Agency
feeds.description: The Libyan News Agency was established on 1 October 1964. The news site brings you fresh and regularly updated reports, covering local and world news on topics such as politics, business, sports, science, and more.

feeds.title: El Khabar
feeds.description: El Khabar is a news, cultural, and diversified website, issued by Dar Tobruk for publishing, distribution and advertising, concerned with local, Arab and international public affairs.

feeds.title: The Libya Observer
feeds.description: The Libya Observer is Libya's leading online news source for comprehensive and feature coverage of daily news. The editorial team of The Libya Observer is committed to delivering comprehensive and authoritative coverage of Libyan news and current affairs as they happen.

feeds.title: 218 NEWS
feeds.description: Continuous coverage of news in Libya and the world and comprehensive sports, economic and social news reports, with a special space for art, women and technology

feeds.title: Libyan Express
feeds.description: Libyan Express is Libya's leading, independent English-language media outlet. A renowned news organisation with a difference. LX is recognised for delivering the latest and most accurate news stories, as well as articles in the realms of politics, business, art, culture, lifestyle, and sports, both in and around Libya.
